name: Texas Hold 'em
tagline: Poker with secret hole cards. Everyone starts with 1000 play chips, the blinds keep rising, last player with chips wins.

modes.name: Tournament
modes.description: 1000 chips each, blinds 10/20 doubling every 8 hands.

modes.name: Turbo
modes.description: 500 chips each, blinds 10/20 doubling every 5 hands.

commands.help: check, or match the current bet

howTo: Everyone gets two secret cards. Five shared cards come in three steps: the flop (3), the turn and the river.
On your turn: fold, check or call, raise, raise half the pot, or go all-in.
Best five-card hand from your two cards plus the five shared ones wins the pot.
Play chips only. Blinds double every few hands; the last player with chips wins.
